Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day privilege escalation vulnerability allowing attackers to bypass security and register rogue administrator accounts by setting arbitrary user meta values, specifically 'wp_capabilities' to gain admin role.
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Ultimate Member plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation via plugin's registration forms to set user meta values
Indicators of Compromise: Usernames: wpenginer, wpadmins, wpengine_backup, se_brutal, segs_brutal
User account with email address associated to exelica.com
Installation of new WordPress plugins and themes
